login.title: Sign in or register
login.hint: You will receive an email with a login link. The link is valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: We sent a login link to {email}. Open the email and follow the link — it is valid for 15 minutes.

error.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
error.consentRequired: You must accept the terms of service and privacy policy
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again in {retryAfter}.
error.providerUnavailable: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again (code: {requestId})

expired.title: Link is not valid
expired.body: The login link has expired or has already been used. Links are valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.

consent.title: Update your consent
consent.body: The terms of service or privacy policy have been updated since your last session. Please review the new versions.

error.title: Sign-in error
error.body: We were unable to sign you in. Please try again (code: {requestId})

archived.title: Account archived
archived.body: Your account is deactivated. Your articles are hidden from readers and do not appear in the feed. You can restore your account at any time.
archived.restoreNote: After restoring, your account will be active again. Your articles remain archived — you will need to republish them separately.

appeal.title: Account blocked
appeal.body: Your account has been blocked. If you believe this is an error, please fill out the form — our team will review your appeal.
appeal.messagePlaceholder: Describe the situation and why you believe the block is a mistake

sent.title: Appeal submitted
sent.body: We have received your appeal and will review it. A response will be sent to {email}.

magicLink.subject: Your Altera login link
magicLink.body:
Hello,

you requested a login link for Altera. Click the button below — it is valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.

If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

newDevice.subject: New sign-in to your Altera account
newDevice.body:
Hello,

someone just signed into your Altera account. If this was you — all is well.

If not — go to your security settings and end any suspicious sessions.

admin.typesDescription: Create and edit article content types
admin.editUserDescription: Change the user details and click “Save”

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: The requested page does not exist or has moved.

internal.title: Internal server error
internal.message: A server error occurred. Try refreshing the page.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.message: You do not have permission to access this page.

generic.title: An error occurred
generic.message: Something went wrong. Try refreshing the page.
